original.target_description: Study 2, perceived nationality of Frank Williams: Canadian-American/shared team identity, win versus loss post-hoc comparison.

n.sample_role: Participants in the Canada/shared-identity win and loss conditions; subgroup analytic N not explicitly reported.
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this comparison; all participants correctly remembered team country. Whole-study recruitment is 104, without condition counts.
n.location: Printed pp. 133–135 (PDF pp. 6–8), Participants, Manipulation Check, nationality results/Figure 2.
n.quote:
Participants were 104 undergraduate students at the University of Western Ontario who received course
credit for participating.

es.location: Printed p. 135 (PDF p. 8), Perceptions of Frank Williams’s Nationality, Canada win versus loss post-hoc test.
es.quote:
